name: story
description: Route master's and doctoral STORY requests to the project's evidence-bound thesis workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route a request to one STORY thesis workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adds the $story router for selecting and running one degree-aware, evidence-bound STORY thesis workflow skill in the current project, and $story-auto for pursuing a stated thesis goal across the unmarked skills, stopping at any explicit-only one.
defaultPrompt: Use $story to show the current thesis status.
Use $story to choose the right workflow for my request.
